description: Source code for the MtpProperty class in the Android Open Source Project, handling media transfer protocol (MTP) property definitions, serialization, and printing.

classes.name: MtpProperty
classes.description: Represents an MTP property with serialization, deserialization, and display capabilities.

methods.name: MtpProperty
methods.description: Constructor initializing property with specific code, type, default value, and writeability.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads property data from a MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes property data to a MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default string value for the property.

methods.name: setCurrentValue
methods.description: Sets the current string value for the property.

methods.name: setFormRange
methods.description: Defines a range form for numeric properties.

methods.name: setFormEnum
methods.description: Defines an enumeration form for the property.

methods.name: setFormDateTime
methods.description: Sets the property form to DateTime.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints a property value into a string buffer.

methods.name: readValue
methods.description: Reads a property value from a data packet based on property type.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a property value into a data packet based on property type.

methods.name: readArrayValues
methods.description: Reads an array of property values from a data packet.

methods.name: writeArrayValues
methods.description: Writes an array of property values into a data packet.
